common.needHelpBody: Write to the OIA admissions team at {email}
common.fileTypes.pdfJpgPng5: PDF, JPG or PNG · up to 5 MB
header.system: NTU Incoming Visiting Research Student Online Application System
header.systemMobileZhBreak: NTU Incoming Visiting Research Student Online Application System
footer.address: 7th Floor, Lixian Hall, No 1, Sec. 4, Roosevelt Road, Taipei City 106319, Taiwan
steps.label: Application steps
process.autosaveSub: Last saved {time} · You can leave and come back any time.
login.title: Log in
login.lead: Use the email address you registered with.
register.title: Create an account
register.lead: Enter your email address. We will send you a link to verify it and set your password.
register.emailHint: Use an address you check often. All notices about your application are sent here.
checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.lead: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to verify your email and set your password.
checkEmail.expiry: The link can be used once and expires in 24 hours.
checkEmail.noEmail: No email? Check your spam folder, or wait a minute before sending it again.
setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.lead: Your email is verified. Choose a password to finish creating your account.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Enter the email address you registered with. We will send you a link to reset your password.
changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.lead: You will stay logged in on this device after the change.
declaration.title: Declaration of Consent
declaration.lead: Please read the declaration below. You only need to do this once, the first time you log in.
declaration.cardNote: Content maintained by the Office of International Affairs.
declaration.agree: I have read and agree to the declaration above.
declaration.disabledHint: Until you tick the box, “Agree and continue” stays disabled.
record.title: My Applications
record.lead: Continue an application in progress, or start a new one when an application period is open.
record.deleteNote: Only applications that have not been submitted can be deleted.
record.approvedLead: Your past visits to NTU. Open one to download certificates or complete departure procedures.
entry.eyebrow: Step 2 · Only for applicants of PRC nationality
entry.why.title: Why you see this step
entry.why.body: Your nationality is China, so NTU applies for your Entry Permit for Taiwan on your behalf. The information below goes to the National Immigration Agency exactly as you enter it.
entry.applicant.lead: Details the National Immigration Agency needs in addition to your application form.
entry.idCardHint: Both sides on one page. PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB.
entry.family.lead: List your parents, and your spouse and children if any.
entry.taiwan.lead: Where you will stay in Taiwan and who we can reach there.
entry.taiwan.addressHint: If you have not booked housing yet, use the host department’s address.
entry.decl.lead: Required by the Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area. Choose one.
entry.decl.never: I have never held a position in, or been a member of, any Party, administrative, military or political organ, institution or group in mainland China.
entry.decl.previously: I previously held such a position or membership.
entry.decl.currently: I currently hold such a position or membership.
entry.decl.detailsHint: Shown only for the second or third option: name the organisation, your position and the period. Providing false information may result in legal liability.
entry.decl.exemption: Mainland residents who committed the offence of insurrection or treason outside Taiwan, and declare it truthfully when applying to enter Taiwan, are exempt from prosecution and punishment.
familyDialog.title: Add family member
upload.progressLead: The list is set by OIA for your application category and identity. Templates are provided where a specific format is needed.
upload.doc.photoDesc: A digital photo that meets the passport photo rules of Taiwan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs: white background, no headwear, and hair must not cover your ears.
upload.doc.proposalDesc: Two to five pages describing the research you plan to do at NTU, agreed with your NTU supervisor. Upload it if your programme asks for one.
upload.doc.transcriptDesc: Official transcript from your home university, in English or Chinese. A scan of the original is accepted.
upload.doc.passportDesc: The page with your photo and personal details. Your passport must be valid for at least six months after your visit ends.
upload.bar1: Files are saved as soon as they finish uploading.
upload.bar2: You can come back and replace any file before you submit.
payment.methodLead: Choose how you would like to pay. Your application is reviewed once payment is confirmed.
payment.cardDesc: Pay online. Payment is confirmed right away.
payment.transferDesc: Transfer the fee to NTU’s account, then upload your transfer receipt. OIA confirms it manually.
payment.bar1: You can review everything on the next page before you submit.
payment.bar2: Payment status updates here once it is confirmed.
preview.title: Check everything before you submit
preview.lead: Once submitted, your application is locked for review. If OIA needs changes, you will get an email and the affected items will open for editing.
preview.confirm: I confirm that the information I have provided is true and complete.
preview.tickHint: Tick the confirmation above to enable Submit.
summary.entryNotRequired: This step only applies to applicants of PRC nationality, so there is nothing to check here.
review.title: Your Application
review.lead: This is the application you submitted. You can read it here but can no longer change it.
review.reviewing: OIA is reviewing your application. We will email you when the result is ready or if anything needs to be supplemented.
supplement.title: Supplement Required
supplement.lead: OIA has asked you to replace the documents below. Only these documents can be changed.
supplement.banner: {n} document needs to be replaced by {date}
supplement.bannerSub: Your application stays on hold until you submit the replacement.
supplement.after: After you submit, OIA will review the new document.
visa.title: Visa Documents
visa.lead: Download these documents to apply for your visa or entry permit.
visa.banner: Congratulations, your application has been approved
visa.bannerSub: Your documents are ready. Bring printed copies to your visa appointment.
visa.entryPermitMeta: Shown only to applicants of PRC nationality. It appears here once OIA has uploaded it.
admission.title: Admission Information
admission.lead: Everything you need before you arrive. Please confirm your attendance at the bottom of this page.
admission.studentIdPending: Shown after OIA sends your registration notice
admission.dormLead: Assigned by the NTU Dormitory Service Office.
admission.attendHint: You can submit this once. Contact OIA if your plans change.
regDocs.title: Registration Documents
regDocs.lead: Upload these documents before you arrive. OIA checks them before registration day.
regDocs.passportDesc: The photo page and the page with your Taiwan entry stamp, in one PDF.
regDocs.healthDesc: Issued by a hospital within the last 3 months, in English or Chinese.
regDocs.insuranceDesc: Must cover your whole visiting period in Taiwan.
regDocs.arcDesc: Required if you stay longer than 6 months.
regDocs.bar: You can replace a file until you submit.
download.title: Download Documents
download.lead: Print these documents and bring them on registration day.
enrollCert.title: Enrollment Certificate
enrollCert.lead: Proof that you are currently a visiting research student at NTU.
enrollCert.meta: PDF · English and Chinese · Valid while you are enrolled
departure.title: Departure Form
departure.lead: Complete the departure procedures before you leave NTU.
departure.note: Download the departure form, collect the signatures listed on it, then upload the signed form here. Your research certificate becomes available after OIA approves it.
departure.docDesc: Signed by your supervisor, the dormitory office and the library.
departure.after: After you submit, OIA will review the form.
researchCert.title: Research Certificate
researchCert.lead: An official certificate of your visiting research at NTU.
researchCert.banner: Your departure form was approved on {date}
researchCert.bannerSub: You can now print your certificate of visiting research.
researchCert.meta: Opens in a new tab, formatted for A4 paper. Print or save it as a PDF.
validation.emailDomain: This email domain cannot receive our mail. Use an address that does not end in .cn, qq.com, 126.com or 163.com.
validation.fileType: This file type is not accepted.
validation.summary: {n} items need attention before you continue.
index.title: Prototype pages
index.lead: Every student-facing page in this prototype. Switch the language in the header to check both versions.
setPassword.expiredBody: Each link can be used once and expires after 24 hours. Request a new one to continue.
record.deleteBody: The draft and any files you uploaded will be removed. This cannot be undone.
record.empty: You have no applications in progress.
payment.outOfScope: The payment page opens here in the final system.
researchCert.printNote: Certificate layout is provided by OIA. This page shows where it opens.
form.category.lead: Your programme category is assigned by the Office of International Affairs.
form.category.label: Category
form.category.hint: Set by OIA staff when your application is opened. Contact us if this looks wrong.
form.home.lead: The university where you are currently enrolled.
form.home.universityHint: Type to search universities in the country you selected.
form.home.fullNameHint: Write the official English name in full, without abbreviations.
form.personal.lead: Use the same spelling as your passport. Fields marked * are required.
form.personal.emailHint: We send every notice here. Addresses ending in .cn, @qq.com, @126.com or @163.com cannot receive our mail.
form.contact.lead: How we reach you while your application is under review.
form.enroll.lead: Your current programme at your home university.
form.ntu.title: NTU Visiting Research Information
form.ntu.lead: Choose your host department and advisor, and the dates you plan to be at NTU.
form.ntu.advisorHint: Contact your advisor before applying. Results are limited to the host college above.
form.ntu.noResult: No advisor matches in this college. Check the spelling or contact the department office.
form.ntu.sample: Sample records shown for layout only.
form.ntu.periodOver: The research period can be at most 180 days. Choose an earlier end date.
form.ntu.periodOrder: The end date must be after the start date.
form.ntu.no: No, I will arrange my own
form.ntu.prefHint: Beds are allocated in order of submission; your first choice is not guaranteed.
form.emergency.lead: The person we contact if something happens to you while you are in Taiwan.
form.emergency.name: Full name
form.noMatch: No match. Keep typing to use your own entry.
validation.passwordRules: Your password does not meet all the requirements below.
